_comment: Cost of the one-shot form-finding stage, per geometry. Measured on the timing machine of Section 6.5.1 (Xeon Gold 5412U). Timings are the Elapsed line each fofin_*.py now prints, which brackets scipy.optimize.minimize only and excludes I/O and plotting. ms_per_iter is one L-BFGS-B iteration: an equilibrium solve plus a gradient. inflate_ms, where present, is the equilibrium solve alone, timed over repeats at the converged densities. The B5 and C5 runs were executed concurrently with each other on separate cores; the D5 samples were taken with the machine otherwise idle.

B5 (6.4.2).note: stopped at the iteration cap, not at convergence; the wall clock is therefore a floor. Runs on input/B5.obj, a coarser mesh than the 497/929 remesh the inverse problem of 6.4.2 uses.

C5 (6.4.3).note: runs on data/C5/C5_remeshed.obj, the same file the inverse problem of 6.4.3 uses; compas welds it to 1114 vertices where the FEM driver reads 1309.

2part (6.4.1).note: not comparable and not measurable here. It is an interactive session - 200 fixed-point fd_numpy steps driven through a compas_view2 viewer - rather than a fitted optimisation over q, and it needs compas_fd and compas_view2, neither installed on the timing machine.
